results.title: Highlight and clear
results.checks: Select 3:16, tap a colour → a ribbon appears; select again → Clear highlight → gone

results.title: Twelve highlight colours and colours of your own
results.checks: Highlight shows the old reader's twelve colours and a + for a colour of your own. Cyan highlights John 3:16; a colour chosen with + highlights 3:14 in exactly that colour and joins the picker after the twelve; right-click takes it away again; both highlights clear
results.note: twelve colours and a +; cyan on 3:16; #2a6fdb on 3:14 and in the picker; right-click removed it; both cleared

results.title: The save window: several folders, rename and delete a folder
results.checks: Select 3:16 → Save opens the save window with My Saves ticked → Add to new 'Memory' → Save: the sidebar's saves list it under My Saves and Memory; Save again opens it as Edit save; Memory's ⋮ → Rename 'Verses' moves it; Edit save → untick My Saves → it is only in Verses; Verses' ⋮ → Delete puts it back in My Saves; Remove from all folders unsaves it
results.note: saved to My Saves and a new folder; renamed, moved, deleted and removed

results.title: Right-click menu on a verse, Copy
results.checks: Right-click John 3:16: the verse toolbar opens at the pointer as a menu; Copy puts the verse's text and reference on the clipboard
results.note: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes i

results.title: Drag the verse toolbar aside
results.checks: On a desktop, the verse toolbar over John 3:3 can be dragged by its edge (not its buttons) 150px right and 60px down; choosing another verse puts it back beside that verse
results.note: dragged by 150, 60; a new choice brought it back beside the verses
